Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the primary function of the plant stem as "structural support" (weight 0.7) over "transport" (weight 0.3). In reality, the stem's most critical biological roles are transporting water and nutrients (xylem/phloem) and providing support. Option A (anchor) only represents support. Option D (elevator) represents the transport function, which is a more fundamental and active role of the stem than just being a static support. By undervaluing the transport function, the Planner selected the wrong analogy (A) instead of the better fit (D).
